name: How long does a roof flashing leak assessment typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof flashing leak assessment typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof flashing leak assessment typically ranges from 1 to 3 hours, depending on the size and complexity of your roof and the number of flashing points. Factors such as the accessibility of your roof and the extent of suspected damage can also influence the time needed. Our goal is to conduct a thorough and accurate assessment without compromising on detail, ensuring all potential leak sources are properly investigated.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assessments usually take 1-3 hours, varying with roof size, complexity, number of flashing points, and accessibility.
